entries.claim: No official XGRIDS route exposes PortalCam raw frames, intrinsics/extrinsics, timestamped LiDAR or IMU as of this refresh; .xbin introduced fleet-wide with firmware 3.0.2 (2025-06) remains undocumented with no export function.
entries.impact: Historical recovery verdict stays partial; official-request letter remains the decisive test.

entries.claim: LCC Studio export tiers pinned: PLY requires Basic+; LCC2 exports SOG (default) or SPZ with optional collision mesh; 3D Tiles (SPZ-v2 option) and USD from Basic+; HD Enhancement/fusion Premium-only; LCC Cloud $800/yr exports .lcc/.ply only.
entries.impact: Vendor-export bootstrap path fully mapped for historical captures.

entries.claim: LCC/LCC2 whitepaper licence permits reading/converting the formats with attribution and share-alike conditions but prohibits training AI models that compete with XGRIDS without written consent; TOU bars reverse engineering of XGRIDS software and competing services; PRC law.
entries.impact: Counsel must read the competing-AI clause before any training consumes LCC-derived inputs (approach L gate).

entries.claim: Lixel K2 (with LixelStudio 4.0, on sale ~2026-06) outputs point cloud + mesh + 3DGS; LixelStudio exports LAS/E57/RCP, panoramas and pano poses for Lixel devices — PortalCam remains excluded from these deliverables.
entries.impact: Prospective hardware comparison; PortalCam is the closed outlier in XGRIDS's own line.

entries.claim: Matterport Pro3 captures 134.2 MP panoramas; documented API delivery caps at 2048px skybox faces, corresponding nominally to ~8192x4096 / ~33.6 MP equirectangular angular sampling. The E57's embedded 4096px cube faces correspond nominally to ~16384x8192 / ~134.2 MP and do not share that API ceiling.
entries.impact: The ~1/4-resolution ceiling applies to API-delivered appearance, not every Matterport-derived lane. The 4096px-face E57 imagery and owned photography are both routes past the API cap; owned photography remains a separately controlled quality/provenance option.
sources: matterport.com/add-ons/e57 + reseller quotations of Matterport E57 overview

entries.claim: Matterport exports (E57/MatterPak) are licensed for commercial use outside the platform, while ToS effective 2026-03-01 prohibit commercial AI/ML training on Matterport Data; repo already encodes modelTrainingUse requires_review.
entries.impact: Counsel gate controls the Grand Hall Brush checkpoints and any cubeface-trained model.

entries.claim: Spark 2.0 (MIT) ships .RAD/.RADC LoD splat trees: 64K-splat chunks, HTTP Range streaming, coarse-first chunk 0; published device budgets Quest<=1M, mobile 1-3M, desktop 1-5M splats; PackedSplats 16 bytes/splat.
entries.impact: Repo already runs Spark 2.0.0 — evaluate .RAD before building bespoke venue chunking.

entries.claim: Cesium shipped 3D Tiles Gaussian-splat LOD streaming (2026-04-27); PlayCanvas published Streamed SOG v1; OGC positions splats for 3D Tiles 2.0; KHR_gaussian_splatting is Release Candidate (2026-02-03) with SPZ and L-GSC compression extensions proposed.
entries.impact: Interchange strategy (SPZ assets, RAD/Streamed-SOG runtime, KHR on ratification) is triply corroborated.

entries.claim: 2DGS/GOF/RaDe-GS/SuGaR/MILo carry the Inria non-commercial licence; PGSR is ZJU non-commercial; GauStudio is MIT-labelled with an Inria-derived rasterizer submodule; MeshSplatting ships GS-licensed components under an Apache top-level; CityGaussian is CC-BY-NC.
entries.impact: Clean meshing route is gsplat's Apache rasterization_2dgs + depth/normal modes + Open3D TSDF/Poisson (reimplement, not vendored).
sources: raw LICENSE files: hbb1/2d-gaussian-splatting, autonomousvision/gaussian-opacity-fields, BaowenZ/RaDe-GS, Anttwo/SuGaR, Anttwo/MILo, zju3dv/PGSR, GAP-LAB-CUHK-SZ/gaustudio, meshsplatting/mesh-splatting, Linketic/CityGaussian

entries.claim: gsplat main branch added PPISP appearance compensation (2026-01), MCMC CUDA inject_noise (2026-05), 3DGUT distortion extensions (2026-03), HiGS fp16 inference, AccuTile, LiDAR rasterization and a SOG-style compression module beyond the pinned 1.5.3 release.
entries.impact: Plan a deliberate version-bump task with regression gates; Config-B stack is on the healthiest line.

entries.claim: NVIDIA Fixer (2025-11, Cosmos-Predict-0.6B) is licensed under the NVIDIA Open Model License permitting commercial use, superseding non-commercial Difix3D+ weights; trained on AV imagery so heritage-interior domain shift must be validated.
entries.impact: Licence-clean engine for the generative-repair lane, still gated by generated-region provenance and human review.

entries.claim: Commercially clean enhancement set: SeedVR2 (Apache, restoration), FLUX.2 klein-4B (Apache, generation), LaMa (Apache) and SAM 2.1 + Wan2.1-VACE (Apache) for people/mirror inpainting, TRELLIS.2-4B (MIT, object-level 3D), Real-ESRGAN (BSD-3); SUPIR, ProPainter, DiffuEraser, MiniMax-Remover, FLUX dev-family confirmed non-commercial.
entries.impact: Enhanced-captured truth class has a full licence-clean toolbox.

entries.claim: World Labs Marble (GA 2025-11-12; World API 2026-01-21) exports Gaussian splats + collider/visual mesh with commercial rights from the Pro tier ($35/mo; Standard-tier ambiguity unresolved); Genie 3 has no API/export; Cosmos is NVIDIA Open Model License; Hunyuan family excludes EU/UK/KR territory.
entries.impact: Marble is the only viable commercial world-model service, restricted to concept/imagination mode; Hunyuan is disqualified for EU-facing products.

entries.claim: SpatialLM (all variants) embeds Meta SceneScript's CC-BY-NC point-cloud encoder, making it non-commercial in practice despite Apache/MIT wrapper code; SceneScript itself is CC-BY-NC.
entries.impact: Excluded from the commercial semantics stack; use geometric layout + Grounded-SAM-2 + OpenMask3D + VLM labelling with human review.

entries.claim: SAM 2.1 (Apache), Grounding DINO / Grounded-SAM-2 (Apache), OpenCLIP (MIT), OpenMask3D (MIT) verified permissive; SAM 3 (2025-11-19) permits commercial use under a custom licence with restricted-use clauses; YOLO-World is GPL-3.
entries.impact: Commercial-safe open-vocabulary 2D->3D semantics stack is available today.
sources: raw LICENSE files: IDEA-Research/Grounded-SAM-2, OpenMask3D/openmask3d, AILab-CVC/YOLO-World

entries.claim: Permissive SLAM core exists for an open capture rig: GLIM (MIT), OKVIS2-X (BSD-3, LiDAR+GNSS), LIO-SAM (BSD-3), Basalt/Kimera-VIO (BSD), KISS-Matcher/small_gicp/TEASER++ (MIT); FAST-LIO2/FAST-LIVO2 (GPL-2), ORB-SLAM3/VINS-Fusion/OpenVINS (GPL-3) are internal-rig-only.
entries.impact: Approach G licence layer de-risked; copyleft SLAM must never link into the shipped product.
sources: raw LICENSE files: koide3/glim, ethz-mrl/okvis2, TixiaoShan/LIO-SAM, hku-mars/FAST-LIO, UZ-SLAMLab/ORB_SLAM3, rpng/open_vins, MIT-SPARK/KISS-Matcher

entries.claim: Leica BLK360 G2 officially documents offline structured-E57 export with embedded panoramas (Cyclone REGISTER 360); Trimble X7 embeds per-station bubble views; NavVis requires IVION; Theta Z1 offers the most open 360 SDK (MIT client, RAW DNG); Insta360 X5 has 72 MP stills behind an application-gated SDK; phone apps Stray Scanner/Record3D/NeRFCapture/Polycam-dev export open per-frame poses/depth.
entries.impact: Named, licence-checked hardware for MIN/PRO/SUPREME capture lanes.

entries.claim: Commercially usable feed-forward geometry now exists: MapAnything Apache checkpoint (2026-01), VGGT-1B-Commercial (gated), Depth Anything 3 Apache sizes (2026-03); DUSt3R/MASt3R/VGGSfM/Fast3R weights remain non-commercial.
entries.impact: Optional priors for sparse-view rooms in the owned-photo lane; ship only Apache/commercial checkpoints.

entries.claim: libE57Format (BSL-1.0) reads embedded Image2D fully via the Simple API; pye57 (MIT) requires low-level BlobNode access; PDAL reads points only; E57 Image2D supports spherical and pinhole representations with per-image pose and scan association.
entries.impact: The documented extraction route matches what prior sessions already executed on cloud_0.e57.

entries.claim: C2PA v2 is fast-tracked as ISO/DIS 22144 with production 2D tooling (c2pa-rs); no ratified provenance standard exists for 3D assets (glTF/USD/PLY/splats).
entries.impact: Keep the internal per-region truth channel canonical; hash-link C2PA-signed 2D evidence; this exceeds current industry practice.

entries.claim: RealityScan 2.2 (2026-06): free under $1M revenue then $1,250/seat/yr, user owns output, Epic may train on scan data by default (opt-out), Windows GUI with Linux CLI via Wine, no macOS; Metashape Pro remains $3,499 cross-platform with Python API and no training clause.
entries.impact: Commercial comparison lane terms pinned; RealityScan default telemetry is a lock-in/rights audit item.

entries.claim: mkkellogg/GaussianSplats3D is no longer actively developed and recommends Spark; PlayCanvas SuperSplat/SplatTransform (MIT) remain the strongest offline splat tooling; Babylon 8.0 added SPZ + SH support.
entries.impact: Spark runtime bet re-validated; adopt PlayCanvas tooling offline.

entries.claim: nerfbaselines (MIT), torchmetrics (Apache) and lpips (BSD-2) are licence-clean; gsplat's own benchmark scripts reproduce official 3DGS metrics for regression baselines.
entries.impact: Bake-off harness has no licence blockers.
sources: raw LICENSE files: nerfbaselines, Lightning-AI/torchmetrics, richzhang/PerceptualSimilarity
